[F1] At order $\ell$, the retained labels are $0,1,\ldots,\ell-2$ and $a\otimes b$ contains $c=|a-b|,|a-b|+2,\ldots,\min(a+b,2\ell-4-a-b)$ ([[thm-temperley-lieb-rank-one-tilting-quotient-fusion-category]], [[thm-temperley-lieb-root-negligible-quotient-is-semisimple]]).
[F2] The conversion theorem identifies the pivotal/ribbon rank-one labels with the same retained Temperley–Lieb fusion labels ([[thm-temperley-lieb-rank-one-pivotal-ribbon-conversion]]).

[F2] For unit quantum integers the projector is idempotent, annihilates the generator, and has partial trace $([3]/[2])p_1$ and closure trace $[3]$ ([[lem-temperley-lieb-jones-wenzl-partial-trace-and-uniqueness]]).

[F3] The two-strand recursion and trace identities give $p_2=1-([1]/[2])U_1$, $p_2^2=p_2$, and $\operatorname{Tr}_2(p_2)=[3]$ ([[def-temperley-lieb-jones-wenzl-recursion-over-unit-denominators]], [[lem-temperley-lieb-jones-wenzl-partial-trace-and-uniqueness]]).
[F2] The closure of $1_1$ has one circle, so $\operatorname{Tr}_1(1_1)=\delta$ ([[lem-temperley-lieb-closure-trace-component-identities]], [[def-temperley-lieb-diagram-category]]).

[F2] [[thm-temperley-lieb-rank-one-pivotal-ribbon-conversion]] gives the exact negative-loop, parity-pivotal ribbon comparison and complete centralizer identification with the full root tilting quotient.

[F4] The JW recursion, partial trace and annihilation are [[lem-temperley-lieb-jones-wenzl-partial-trace-and-uniqueness]]; complete retained path units and the exact boundary quotient are [[lem-temperley-lieb-root-fusion-paths-have-nonzero-pairings]] and [[thm-temperley-lieb-root-negligible-quotient-is-semisimple]].

[L1] For the Temperley–Lieb specialization, the partial trace is the cap/cup closure of [[def-temperley-lieb-closure-trace-and-partial-trace]], and the component-counting identity is proved in [[lem-temperley-lieb-closure-trace-component-identities]].
[F2] [[def-temperley-lieb-closure-trace-and-partial-trace]] and [[lem-temperley-lieb-closure-trace-component-identities]] give unnormalized partial closure and its composition rules.
[F3] [[lem-temperley-lieb-jones-wenzl-partial-trace-and-uniqueness]] gives $U_if=fU_i=0$, its one-dimensional corner and $\operatorname{ptr}_m(f)=([m+1]/[m])p_{m-1}$.

[F2] The JW projector has “coefficient $1$ on the identity diagram,” is nonzero and idempotent, and is annihilated on both sides by the elementary generators. Its corner is $p_a\mathrm{TL}_ap_a=\mathbb C(q)p_a$, its recursion is $p_{a+1}=P_a-([a]/[a+1])P_aU_aP_a$ with $P_a=p_a\otimes1$, and $\operatorname{Tr}_a(p_a)=[a+1]$. The construction and partial trace use only the stated nonzero denominator quantum integers ([[lem-temperley-lieb-jones-wenzl-partial-trace-and-uniqueness]], Statement, Facts [F1], and Proof).

[F6] Closing a basis diagram with $c$ circles has value $\delta^c$, and this extends linearly. Closure is cyclic and factors through the stated cup/cap partial trace, with no division by the loop value ([[def-temperley-lieb-closure-trace-and-partial-trace]], Definition; [[lem-temperley-lieb-closure-trace-component-identities]], Statement).

[F6] Closing a last identity strand gives a factor $\delta$, closing $U_{n-1}$ on its last strand gives the straight identity on the remaining strands, and full closure factors through the partial trace ([[lem-temperley-lieb-closure-trace-component-identities]]).

At $q=e^{\pi i/\ell}$, $\ell\ge3$, and $0\le r,s,t\le\ell-2$, the pairing is positive when the triangle/parity conditions hold and $r+s+t\le2\ell-4$; it is zero for a triangle/parity triple above that level. [F5] [[lem-temperley-lieb-boundary-tensor-ideal-has-the-embedded-components]] identifies every tensor-ideal endomorphism component with the fixed embedded two-sided ideal. [[lem-negligible-morphisms-form-a-tensor-ideal-by-partial-trace]] proves tensor-ideal closure of negligible morphisms.

[F2] The full toral-character divided-power category, Weyl/dual-Weyl tensor filtrations, tilting classification and all-endomorphism negligible trace calculation are supplied by [[def-temperley-lieb-rank-one-lusztig-tilting-category]], [[lem-temperley-lieb-rank-one-weyl-and-dual-weyl-filtrations]] and [[lem-temperley-lieb-rank-one-tilting-character-and-dimension]]. [F3] The finite integral R-series gives the full braiding, ribbon identities and twists on the actual tiltings; the signed TL comparison with parity-corrected pivot gives positive dimensions and retains the exact root-path/trace-radical quotient and all-rank semisimplified centralizer.
